correctness.rationale: Weights wi=1/ai give principal Brieskorn–Pham polynomial weight 1, Σwi=2, and socle monomial g weight Σ(ai−2)/ai=m−4>1. The weighted principal part has isolated critical point; the higher-weight top monomial preserves semiquasihomogeneous Milnor number μ=∏(ai−1) and the Newton principal spectrum, yielding minimal exponent 2 (standard Newton nondegeneracy/positive-weight deformation theorem). The weighted initial Milnor quotient is C[xi]/(xi^(ai−1)) with one-dimensional top socle represented by g. Euler identity Σwi xi∂iF=f0+(m−4)g implies [F]=(5−m)[g], nonzero for m≥6 and spanning the socle. The Tjurina quotient therefore removes exactly one dimension, τ=μ−1; K. Saito μ=τ criterion establishes nonquasihomogeneity. Friedman–Laza higher DB/rational criterion gives boundary equality. Independently computed a lexicographic Gröbner standard-monomial basis for the example after eliminating three quadratic variables: τ=124 and μ=125, in agreement. Finite calculation is only the example; general claim is analytic.
